data.title: Release 0.6.0: documentation in the journal and the honest failure path
data.description: CHANGELOG entry, version bump to 0.6.0, README updated for kadence doc, generated sections refreshed. The release notes lead with the compact warning: 0.5.0 and earlier delete doc.* events when they compact a month, so everyone updates before anyone compacts. The owner publishes by tag; an agent does not.
